bonuses: Light's Share: 20% chance on hit to Burn the enemy for 4% of that hit's damage per second for 4 s. Killing an enemy that carries a Poison, Bleed or Burn grants a Ration Light charge (max 1, kept between fights): your next meal is not used up.

src.via: Selyth, the Lantern Veil (Unique Glowing Jellyfish)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Selyth, the Lantern Veil; about 0.12% a kill of a Glowing Jellyfish in a combat area

items.name: Wreckshot
items.desc: Dask gives the first shot to the sea and puts the second on his tab.
bonuses: Sunken Reckoning: Grows with your Champion and Unique kills while you wear it (kept with the character); each step adds to the ones before: 25 = +10% damage, 50 = +6% crit chance, 75 = -8% attack interval, 100 = +25% damage against elites, 125 = +1 loot roll per elite kill.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Dask, the Wreckshot; about 0.12% a kill of a Drowned Rifleman in a combat area

items.name: Gatebreaker
items.desc: In Kelsarin, a gate is just a wall that hasn't taken its first blow.
bonuses: Gate's Verdict: +40% damage while the current enemy is a Champion or Unique, on top of this item's +35% max hit. Breaking one opens the gate: your next fight starts with +40% damage for 10 s.

src.via: Gharom, the Wastes Gatebreaker (Unique Kelsarin Mauler)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Gharom, the Wastes Gatebreaker; about 0.12% a kill of a Kelsarin Mauler in a combat area

items.name: Cavern Bastion
items.desc: The mountain's first four answers are echoes; the fifth is stone.
bonuses: Fifth Stratum: Every 5th enemy attack that lands at least one direct hit deals 50% less direct damage (added to your other damage reduction, like the game's own); the count carries between fights. Full misses and damage over time don't count, and a multi-hit attack counts once.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Khazren, the Cavern-Jaw; about 0.12% a kill of a Dracolith Tyrant in a combat area

items.name: Pinnacle Diadem
items.desc: Every stone in Ydrak's crown was once someone else's last refuge.
bonuses: Stolen Bulwark: Your first successful hit in each fight also takes up to 2 hits of the enemy's ward (besides its normal damage) and gives you 2 hits of ward for 10 s, or 4 if the enemy had any ward.

src.via: Ydrak, the Pinnacle Diadem (Unique Elder Wyvern)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Ydrak, the Pinnacle Diadem; about 0.12% a kill of a Elder Wyvern in a combat area

items.name: Goremantle
items.desc: The more ribs it gathers, the hungrier it grows.
bonuses: Unsated Triumph: Each kill grants a Hunger stack (max 10) giving +3% damage each (max +30%); stacks carry over to new enemies. Eating any food clears all stacks, but lifesteal and other healing do not.

src.via: Kharvul, the Bloodlands Goremantle (Unique Blood Fiend)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Kharvul, the Bloodlands Goremantle; about 0.12% a kill of a Blood Fiend in a combat area

items.name: Thunder Traces
items.desc: Teyr's claw has passed; its thunder has yet to settle the score.
bonuses: Delayed Thunder: Every 4th successful hit in a fight records 70% of the HP it removed (capped at 15% of the enemy's max HP). 2 s later, if the same enemy is still alive, that amount strikes again; it cannot crit.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Teyr, the Thunder-Prowler; about 0.12% a kill of a Storm Lynx in a combat area

items.name: Starbound Mantle
items.desc: In Vaelis's sky, no star rules alone.
bonuses: Sum of Stars: Each successful hit grants an Orbit stack after it lands (max 20), each giving +2% damage to later attacks (max +40%). Misses neither grant nor remove stacks; all stacks reset when the fight ends.

src.via: Vaelis, the Crater Astromancer (Unique Starblighted Mage)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Vaelis, the Crater Astromancer; about 0.12% a kill of a Starblighted Mage in a combat area

items.name: Usurper's Circle
items.desc: Thulvek mimics not your face, but the worth you leave behind.
bonuses: Other Hand's Echo: Copies the bonuses (not the equipment stats) of the ring in its paired ring slot (1-2, 3-4, 5-6). Unique rings are not copied; two Usurper's Circles copy nothing.

src.via: Thulvek, the Wreckbound Usurper (Unique Drowned Possessor)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Thulvek, the Wreckbound Usurper; about 0.12% a kill of a Drowned Possessor in a combat area

items.name: Soulstring Quiver
items.desc: Every arrow Qor looses comes back with a soul beside it.
bonuses: Returning Arrow: Ranged only. Never used up when you shoot. Every 5th successful ranged attack (every 4th against elites) fires a free extra shot at 75% damage that can crit.

src.via: Qor, the Soulstring Warden (Unique Phantasm Wraith)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Qor, the Soulstring Warden; about 0.12% a kill of a Phantasm Wraith in a combat area

items.name: Fourfold Writ
items.desc: Ithrek's four hands renew four seals; the book never forgets whose turn it is.
bonuses: Four Seals: Magic only. Every 4th spell keeps its runes and prayer points and opens the next seal in order: 1) +40% damage on that spell; 2) Burn for 3% of your max hit per second for 5 s; 3) heal 5% of your max HP; 4) the enemy's next attack deals 50% less damage. The cycle is kept between fights.

src.via: Ithrek, the Fourfold Vigil (Unique Sentinel Minion)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Ithrek, the Fourfold Vigil; about 0.12% a kill of a Sentinel Minion in a combat area

items.name: Threevoice Cleaver
items.desc: Three throats, one blade, and none of them ever agreed.
bonuses: Three Voices: After every 2 successful hits, your next attack deals +35% damage and the enemy's evasion is 30% lower for it (a miss does not use it up; it starts over each fight).

src.note: 15% each time you kill Nulgrath, the Tower-Stitched; about 0.12% a kill of a Melee Amalgamation in a combat area

items.name: Root-Shear Claws
items.desc: It cut the roots first, so nothing could hold on.
bonuses: Deep Wound: 25% chance on hit to Bleed for 30% of the hit's damage over 4 s (max 5 stacks); each bleed tick can crit. Hitting a bleeding enemy refreshes your bleeds, but direct hit damage is -20%.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Ssilak, the Root-Shearer; about 0.12% a kill of a Mangrove Mantis in a combat area

items.name: Thornstep Spinecoat
items.desc: Tavio never stopped dancing; the thorns kept time.
bonuses: Thorn Dance: The damage you reflect hits 2.5 times (it can crit) and has a 25% chance to Bleed for 30% of it over 4 s (3 stacks at most); these hits trigger no other items. Your own attacks deal 10% less damage.

src.via: Tavio, the Thornstep Maestro (Unique Dancing Cactus)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Tavio, the Thornstep Maestro; about 0.12% a kill of a Dancing Cactus in a combat area

items.name: Tollkeeper Greaves
items.desc: Everyone pays the toll. Some just pay it slower.
bonuses: Last Breath: Your HP cannot go above 50% of your max HP (auto-eat still uses your full max HP). 15% of the direct damage you take is given back and taken over 4 s instead; that delayed damage cannot kill you.

src.via: Dhevran, the Wastes Tollkeeper (Unique Kelsarin Skirmisher)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Dhevran, the Wastes Tollkeeper; about 0.12% a kill of a Kelsarin Skirmisher in a combat area

items.name: Sunken Volley
items.desc: Two arrows to a string, drowned and still drawn.
bonuses: Twin Volley: Each attack fires a second arrow: both deal 60% damage. The second uses one more ammo and rolls its own hit and crit.

src.via: Nerzul, the Sunken Volley (Unique Ranged Amalgamation)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Nerzul, the Sunken Volley; about 0.12% a kill of a Ranged Amalgamation in a combat area

items.name: Twin-Eye Longwatch
items.desc: One eye to find you, one eye to never miss.
bonuses: Still Heartbeat: +60% attack interval, but your shots almost never miss and hit for at least 80% of your max hit. The first shot of each fight is a guaranteed crit.

src.via: Azkiel, the Twin-Eyed Vigil (Unique Sentinel Minion)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Azkiel, the Twin-Eyed Vigil; about 0.12% a kill of a Sentinel Minion in a combat area

items.name: Conclave Spire
items.desc: Four voices argue; the right one always wins.
bonuses: Council's Voice: Magic only. At the start of each fight your spell's element switches to the enemy's weakness (the spell's effects and rune costs stay; nothing changes against Neutral enemies). Hits with elemental advantage deal +15% damage on top of the normal bonus.

src.via: Zhulen, the Manyfold Conclave (Unique Magic Amalgamation)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Zhulen, the Manyfold Conclave; about 0.12% a kill of a Magic Amalgamation in a combat area

items.name: Sanguine Liturgy
items.desc: Runes are a poor man's blood.
bonuses: Blood Rite: Spells keep their runes (you still need one cast's runes in the bank); each cast costs 3% of your current HP instead (never below 1 HP). With magic, +1% damage per 2% of missing HP (max +30%).

src.via: Yzren, the Sanguine Liturgist (Unique Blood Summoner)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Yzren, the Sanguine Liturgist; about 0.12% a kill of a Blood Summoner in a combat area

items.name: Plungeheart Tusk
items.desc: Cold enough to stop a heart, sharp enough to break it.
bonuses: Ice Shatter: Every 5th hit freezes the enemy for 1 turn (count kept between enemies), and frozen enemies take +40% damage. When your freeze ends on a living enemy it shatters for 6% of its max HP (max 200% of your max hit, halved vs elites); enemies that can't be frozen become Brittle for 1 turn (+20% damage taken) and take a 3% shatter instead.

src.via: Hrokk, the Plungeheart Colossus (Unique Ice Yeti)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Hrokk, the Plungeheart Colossus; about 0.12% a kill of a Ice Yeti in a combat area

items.name: Hollow Harvest Crown
items.desc: Empty inside, and harder for it.
bonuses: Hollow Harvest: Your max hit points are 35% lower, and you gain +6 ward. Your ward is full at the start of each fight, regains 1 every 4 s (not for 2 s after you are hit), and eating gives 1 back (once in 2 s).

src.via: Orren, the Hollow Harvest (Unique Jack O Lantern)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Orren, the Hollow Harvest; about 0.12% a kill of a Jack O Lantern in a combat area

items.name: Veil-Antler Reprieve
items.desc: The stag walked out of the veil once. It can show you the way.
bonuses: Back From the Veil: Once every 3 minutes of fighting (the wait is kept when you stop or restart): when you drop below 20% HP or take a fatal blow you survive, heal 40% of your max HP, enemy attacks do no damage for 3 s, and you gain +30% damage and -15% attack interval for 15 s.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Auvrel, the Veil-Antlered; about 0.12% a kill of a Spirit Stag in a combat area

items.name: Threefold Decree
items.desc: Urzath ruled three ways at once, and every way was his.
bonuses: Three Jaws' Edict: The combat triangle always favours you, with One Style's class too (which otherwise turns the triangle off): you get its advantage (+10% max hit and less damage taken) against every enemy and never its penalty.

src.via: Urzath, the Threefold Dominion (Unique King Black Dragon)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Urzath, the Threefold Dominion; about 0.12% a kill of a King Black Dragon in a combat area

items.name: Ringleader's Tally
items.desc: He never counted the pieces, only the sets.
bonuses: Ringmaster's Count: Every equipment set you wear at least 2 real pieces of counts as one piece more (wizard sets, Dawnsteel, Meteorite, Ironsteel...). Sets with 0-1 pieces get nothing, and the extra piece never starts another set.

src.area: Act 1 - In the Thick of It
src.note: 15% each time you kill Gorvuk, the Thicket Ringleader; about 0.12% a kill of a Ringleader in a combat area

items.name: Amber Reservoir
items.desc: A drop of venom, kept forever in gold.
bonuses: Amber Vault: Combat potions in your toolbelt are never used up, and their stat bonuses (damage, accuracy, evasion, protection, healing...) are 1.5 times; chances, intervals and durations stay the same.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Ophis, the Venom-Siphon; about 0.12% a kill of a Poisonous Serpent in a combat area

items.name: Dune-Vizier Wrappings
items.desc: The sand keeps prayers the way it keeps the dead.
bonuses: Sealed Prayers: Prayers cost 50% fewer points (at least 1) and their bonuses are 30% stronger. Each kill gives 15 prayer points.

src.via: Neshu, the Dune-Bound Vizier (Unique Sand Mummy)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Neshu, the Dune-Bound Vizier; about 0.12% a kill of a Sand Mummy in a combat area

items.name: Oathbound Gauntlets
items.desc: An oath sworn twice is never broken.
bonuses: Soul Anvil: When an on-hit effect of your gear (bleed, burn, stun, wither...) does not happen on a hit, it rolls once more: a 20% chance becomes 36%.

src.via: Deyrath, the Moonscar Oathbound (Unique Starblighted Warrior)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Deyrath, the Moonscar Oathbound; about 0.12% a kill of a Starblighted Warrior in a combat area

items.name: Abyssal Beacon
items.desc: Light in the deep does not guide. It calls.
bonuses: Deep Signal: Twice the chance of Champions and Uniques (with your other elite bonuses, at most 2.5 times). Every elite gets one more affix and +20% HP, and drops one more Rare (3-affix) item.

src.via: Suvrill, the Abyssal Beacon (Unique Glowing Eel)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Suvrill, the Abyssal Beacon; about 0.12% a kill of a Glowing Eel in a combat area

items.name: Scrapwind Treads
items.desc: Baskor walked where the hunt was, and took what was left.
bonuses: Scrap Hunter: On a Slayer task each task monster you kill gives +1% damage and makes your rare item chance 1% higher (up to +30%, so 2% a kill becomes 2.6%), and task monsters come 30% faster. When the task ends the stacks go and you keep 1 token (1 at most): your next elite kill drops one more Rare (3-affix) item.

src.via: Baskor, the Scrapwind Marauder (Unique Kelsarin Wastelander)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Baskor, the Scrapwind Marauder; about 0.12% a kill of a Kelsarin Wastelander in a combat area

items.name: Dreamtide Orb
items.desc: She sleeps; the tide does the rest.
bonuses: Dream Tide: Every 4th hit puts the enemy to sleep for 1 turn (at most once every 8 s per enemy); immune enemies become Drowsy instead and their next attack deals -25% damage. Your first hit on a sleeping or stunned enemy deals +80% damage and cannot miss.

src.via: Iovra, the Dream-Tide Regent (Unique Mesmeris, the Slumbering Princess)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Iovra, the Dream-Tide Regent; about 0.12% a kill of a Mesmeris, the Slumbering Princess in a combat area

items.name: Ossuary Magazine
items.desc: The bones always come back to the quiver.
bonuses: Bone Rain: Ranged only. Never used up when you shoot. Every 4th ranged attack deals double damage.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Sarn, the Barrens Ossuary; about 0.12% a kill of a Dreadspine in a combat area

items.name: Brood-Sign Grips
items.desc: A thousand eggs, and every one hatches hungry.
bonuses: Thousand Eggs: Every 3rd hit summons a spiderling (max 3) that lives 8 s and attacks every 2 s for 20% of your max hit, using your accuracy. Spiderlings cannot crit or trigger items.

src.via: Aulzha, the Thousand-Egg Warden (Unique Zuraxa, the Brood Mother)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Aulzha, the Thousand-Egg Warden; about 0.12% a kill of a Zuraxa, the Brood Mother in a combat area

items.name: Hemal Palimpsest
items.desc: Written over and over, in the same red ink.
bonuses: Fifth Seal: Magic only. Every 5th spell is followed by a free echo: one more hit of your spell (its own hit roll, can crit).

src.via: Vezhar, the Hemal Sealkeeper (Unique Sanguis, the Crimson Arcanist)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Vezhar, the Hemal Sealkeeper; about 0.12% a kill of a Sanguis, the Crimson Arcanist in a combat area

items.name: Mirage Astrolabe
items.desc: It points where the stars should be.
bonuses: False Horizon: Your spell imbuement's bonuses are multiplied by 1.8, or by 2.7 on every 6th spell.

src.via: Zahim, the Mirage Wayfarer (Unique Sand Nomad Mage)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Zahim, the Mirage Wayfarer; about 0.12% a kill of a Sand Nomad Mage in a combat area

items.name: Caravan Warcloak
items.desc: Zafir's road had three turns: stab, slash or crush.
bonuses: Caravan Road: Melee only, by stance: Stab +30% accuracy; Slash 20% chance on hit to cause Bleed; Crush stuns for 1 turn on every 4th successful hit (once in 8 s). Nothing in Block stance, or with ranged or magic.

src.via: Zafir, the Caravan Reaver (Unique Sand Nomad Warrior)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Zafir, the Caravan Reaver; about 0.12% a kill of a Sand Nomad Warrior in a combat area

items.name: Twin-Lurker Fangs
items.desc: Skarn never needed a second blade. He just liked the second wound.
bonuses: Twin Strike: On hit, 25% chance to strike once more for 50% of a normal hit (it rolls its own accuracy and critical hit, and triggers nothing else).

src.via: Skarn, the Twin-Blade Lurker (Unique Golbin Ambusher)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Skarn, the Twin-Blade Lurker; about 0.12% a kill of a Golbin Ambusher in a combat area

items.name: Bell-Yoke Wand
items.desc: The herd came home to the bell. So did everything else.
bonuses: Bell Toll: Magic only. Every 3rd spell you cast (misses count) is followed by a bell strike for 35% of a normal hit of your spell (it rolls its own accuracy and critical hit, and triggers nothing else).

src.note: 15% each time you kill Mora, the Bell-Yoked; about 0.12% a kill of a Magic Cow in a combat area

items.name: Resin Hoard Ring
items.desc: Ploxx kept everything it swallowed. This ring was the least sticky part.
bonuses: Resin Shell: When food restores your hit points, you gain 2 more hits of ward for 6 s: the next 2 hits you take go through it and do less damage. At most once every 8 s; your other ward stays.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Ploxx, the Resin-Hoarder; about 0.12% a kill of a Blue Slime in a combat area

items.name: Divide Sentinel's Aegis
items.desc: The mountain does not dodge. It waits, and then it answers.
bonuses: Sentinel's Answer: Melee only. Every 3rd enemy attack that hits you readies one Answer (only one is kept; a new one at most every 8 s from when the last was readied): your next successful melee hit deals +40% damage and has a 20% chance to stun for 1 turn.

src.via: Keldrun, the Divide Sentinel (Unique Stone Elemental)
src.note: 15% each time you kill Keldrun, the Divide Sentinel; about 0.12% a kill of a Stone Elemental in a combat area

items.name: Talon of the Divide
items.desc: Kethra struck once to mark you, and once more to finish it.
bonuses: Rising Edge: After each successful hit your critical hit chance is rolled again, on its own: on a success you gain an Edge (3 at most; each new Edge renews them all to 15 s), +10% critical damage each. With 3 Edges your next attack is a sure critical hit with +80% critical damage in all (the Edges' +30% and 50% more), and the Edges are spent.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Kethra, the Divide's Talon; about 0.12% a kill of a Harpy in a combat area

items.name: Divide-Fang Howler
items.desc: Kaul's pack is long dead. The howl still answers.
bonuses: Pack Howl: On hit, 25% chance to gain 1 stack of the game's Rage (Rage from anything else counts too). Each stack: +2% damage, up to +10%. At 5 stacks your next successful hit howls: it uses up all your Rage and stuns the enemy for 1 turn. A howl at most every 10 s; while it waits your Rage stays and keeps its bonus.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Kaul, the Divide-Fang; about 0.12% a kill of a Dire Wolf in a combat area

items.name: Veinbound Chalice
items.desc: Sareth never spilled a drop. She saved them for later.
bonuses: Overflow: +5% lifesteal. Lifesteal healing your full hit points cannot take is stored as Blood (up to 20% of your max hit points). When you drop below 40% hit points, all the Blood heals you at once. While the Blood is full you deal +15% damage.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Sareth, the Veinbound Regent; about 0.12% a kill of a Vampire in a combat area

items.name: Barrens Hush
items.desc: You never hear Osvyr coming. That is the point.
bonuses: Hush: Each successful hit, on its own, has a 12% chance to Blind the enemy for 4 of its turns and an 8% chance to Wither it for 6 of its turns (the game's own Blind and Wither). You deal +15% damage to an enemy that is Blinded or Withered, from any source; it does not add up when it has both.

src.note: 15% each time you kill Osvyr, the Barrens Hush; about 0.12% a kill of a Nightwing in a combat area
